price_book_title: Travis DaVinci Custom Linear Fireplaces 2025 Price Catalog (Gas)
price_field_note: The catalog publishes two price columns per fireplace: COST (the U.S. Builder/Distributor wholesale price - what Benson pays - mapped to dealer_price) and MSRP (suggested retail - mapped to msrp). Across this catalog MSRP is consistently 2x COST. DaVinci units are custom-built linear gas fireplaces priced by configuration x glass length (width) x glass height; the price book does not publish per-model BTU input, depth, or ignition spec rows (BTU scales with burner count - see DaVinci install manuals/spec sheets), so btu_input and depth_inches are null. Width_inches = glass length; height_inches = glass height. Category I-IV refer to the number of shipping sections, not fuel type.

models.model_name: DaVinci 'L' Corner Fireplace - Inside Corner Section
models.accessories_required: Requires 'T' installation in venting. Standard 8" air intake diameter (6" not an option). No heat exchanger option.
models.notes: 'L' Corner Fireplace corner section. Not a standalone unit: total unit price = Price L (left side fireplace) + Price R (right side fireplace) + this corner price. L/R sides mix-and-match Single Sided or See-Thru styles within Category I or II lengths. Outside and Inside Corner are priced identically.
